content:
I don’t know if anyone else relates to this, but I feel stuck in a loop when it comes to AI. 😅🤯

Whenever I write something on my own—whether it’s a LinkedIn post, a message, or even a small write-up—I somehow end up opening ChatGPT and saying:
💬 "Hey buddy, can you redraft this and suggest some better words?" 🤖✨
And honestly, the result is usually much better than what I originally wrote. 🚀

But then my friends say:
👉 "Likhwa liya ChatGPT se!" 😭😂

On the flip side, when I don’t use AI, the same people tell me:
👉 "Bhai, ChatGPT use kiya kar. AI is the future. Tujhe use karna hi nahi aata!" 😑🙄

So now I’m genuinely confused. 🤔

Should AI be a tool that helps us express our thoughts better, or should we avoid using it to keep everything 100% original? 🧠⚖️

Personally, I feel the ideas are still mine—the experiences are mine, the thoughts are mine. AI just helps me present them better. ✍️✨

At this point, I feel like I’m stuck between:
🔹 "You use too much AI."
🔹 "You don’t use enough AI."
😅😂
What’s your take on this?
Do you use AI as a writing partner 🤝, a learning tool 📚, or do you prefer doing everything yourself? 💭

Drop your thoughts below 👇

P.S. 😜 Before anyone comments "Likhwa liya ChatGPT se" ... yes, this post was also written with the help of my buddy ChatGPT. 🤖❤️
